headline: PM Tarique Rahman meets Kuwait Crown Prince in New York
summary: The two leaders discussed expanding labour recruitment, trade, and investment to deepen bilateral ties between Bangladesh and Kuwait.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Kuwait’s Crown Prince Sheikh Sabah Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Mubarak Al-Sabah on Friday morning at Kuwait’s Permanent Mission in New York.
The meeting took place while the Prime Minister is in New York to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly.
The two leaders focused on expanding the recruitment of Bangladeshi workers and increasing trade and investment between the two nations.
Tarique Rahman recalled the role of former president Ziaur Rahman and former prime minister Khaleda Zia in building the same relations.
He emphasized the need to diversify and deepen these ties for the mutual benefit of the people of both countries.
The discussions also covered regional and international issues, emphasizing continued coordination on matters of common interest.
The Prime Minister called for more high-level political engagement between Dhaka and Kuwait City to foster growth in manpower and economic cooperation.
caption:
Expanding labour recruitment and trade: PM Tarique Rahman meets Kuwait's Crown Prince in New York.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman met with Kuwait’s Crown Prince Sheikh Sabah Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Mubarak Al-Sabah on Friday morning at Kuwait’s Permanent Mission in New York.

The meeting took place while the Prime Minister is in New York to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly.

The two leaders focused on expanding the recruitment of Bangladeshi workers and increasing trade and investment between the two nations.

Tarique Rahman recalled the role of former president Ziaur Rahman and former prime minister Khaleda Zia in building the same relations.

He emphasized the need to diversify and deepen these ties for the mutual benefit of the people of both countries.

The discussions also covered regional and international issues, emphasizing continued coordination on matters of common interest.

The Prime Minister called for more high-level political engagement between Dhaka and Kuwait City to foster growth in manpower and economic cooperation.

topic: Putin: Russia not preparing for conflict with Europe
headline_marked: Putin claims [[Russia is not preparing for conflict with Europe]]
headline: Putin claims Russia is not preparing for conflict with Europe
summary: The Russian President denied warnings from NATO members about potential attacks on Europe, stating there is no realistic reason to escalate tensions.
details: Russian President Vladimir Putin told reporters in Saint Petersburg that Russia is not preparing for any kind of conflict with Europe, dismissing warnings from several NATO member states.
Putin criticized European nations that have issued attack warnings, arguing that Russia has no realistic reason to increase tensions in the region.

The statement comes after Germany alleged that Moscow planned a drone attack on Leipzig airport in August, and Poland warned of potential Russian drone and missile strikes on countries supporting Ukraine.
Regarding peace talks with Ukraine, Putin stated that Russia is reviewing its position on restarting negotiations following recent Ukrainian attacks.
He added that while all proposals for discussion are on the table and everything is possible, Russia will carefully consider what steps to take in response to Ukraine's actions.
caption:
Is Russia planning a strike on Europe? Vladimir Putin says no.

Russian President Vladimir Putin told reporters in Saint Petersburg that Russia is not preparing for any kind of conflict with Europe, dismissing warnings from several NATO member states.

Putin criticized European nations that have issued attack warnings, arguing that Russia has no realistic reason to increase tensions in the region.

The statement comes after Germany alleged that Moscow planned a drone attack on Leipzig airport in August, and Poland warned of potential Russian drone and missile strikes on countries supporting Ukraine.

Regarding peace talks with Ukraine, Putin stated that Russia is reviewing its position on restarting negotiations following recent Ukrainian attacks.

He added that while all proposals for discussion are on the table and everything is possible, Russia will carefully consider what steps to take in response to Ukraine's actions.
